a_0_exemption.what: A_0's own word 6-grams: the released compact registry is the legal source of shared phrasing, so a gram of the candidate that is also a gram of an evaluation query is forgiven when the registry already carries it. illegal = (candidate & evaluation) - registry
a_0_exemption.why_committable: the compact registry is public released text of the Audio2Tool distribution, not evaluation speech; a reviewer has to see exactly which overlaps the gate forgives

boundary: zero model, GPU, tokenizer, embedder, retriever, scorer, network, audio-decode and paid-API contacts. Pure text over the released tier manifests' invocation fields and tools_registry.csv

evaluation_grams.rule: for every row of the population: its 'query', its 'user_request' when it has one, and EVERY string value of every 'chat_history' turn (the turn's 'content', its 'path' and its 'role'). Inherited verbatim from KC-A1's gate so the two counts reproduce; the path and role strings are a defect of that rule and are reported separately rather than silently dropped
evaluation_grams.set_sha256_convention: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted space-joined grams, UTF-8, no trailing newline. The SET is pinned and never written: a 6-gram is six verbatim words of an evaluation query, so a committed list of them would be the leak this gate exists to prevent

evaluation_grams_speaker_only.rule: the same rows, but only 'query', 'user_request' and each chat turn's 'content' -- what the SPEAKER actually says, with no wav path and no role token

gold_not_read.why: the gate compares candidate text against what the SPEAKER says, which is the only leakage channel a rewritten description could have. No answer field of any evaluation row is opened

how_the_gate_is_run: rails.proposer.validate_candidate_artifact(candidate, registry_rows=..., token_counter=<the resident server's /tokenize route>, compact_baseline_tokens=3581, evaluation_query_texts=scripts.build_a2t_evo_decontamination.evaluation_invocation_texts(...), registry_text=render_registry_compact(...), exemplar_texts=<the construction rows the draw showed>). The token counter is the ONLY part that needs a server, which is why candidate pricing is a separate bounded-discovery-probe row and this one is model-free

identity_anchors.on_disagreement: SystemExit before a byte is written

inherited_rule_defect.decision: KEEP the inherited superset as the GATE set. It is strictly stricter -- it can only cause a refusal, never admit a candidate the speaker-only set would refuse -- and keeping it is what lets KC-A1's two anchors reproduce exactly. The speaker-only pin is recorded beside it so a later cell can narrow the rule knowingly rather than by accident
inherited_rule_defect.what: KC-A1's gate collected EVERY string value of a chat_history turn, which is the turn's content plus its wav 'path' and its 'role'. 9252 of the 77899 grams therefore come from path and role strings rather than from anything a speaker said
inherited_rule_defect.why_not: both KC-A1 arms passed with ZERO shared grams, and a strictly larger refusal set cannot turn a pass into a different pass

tokenizer: rails.proposer.word_ngrams: lower-cased alphanumeric word n-grams, one tokenizer for the candidate side, the evaluation side and the registry side
